james.4.p1.b1.text: What causes conflicts and quarrels among you?

james.4.p1.b2.text: Don’t they come from the passions at war within you?

james.4.p1.b3.text: You crave what you do not have … You do not have, because you do not ask.

james.4.p1.b4.text: And when you do ask, you do not receive, because you ask with wrong motives, that you may squander it on your pleasures.

james.4.p2.b1.text: … Do you not know that friendship with the world is hostility toward God?

james.4.p2.b2.text: Or do you think the Scripture says without reason that the Spirit He caused to dwell in us yearns with envy?

james.4.p2.b3.text: … This is why it says: “God opposes the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”

james.4.p3.b1.text: Submit yourselves, then, to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.

james.4.p3.b2.text: Draw near to God, and He will draw near to you.

james.4.p3.b3.text: Cleanse your hands, you sinners, and purify your hearts, you double-minded.

james.4.p3.b4.text: Humble yourselves before the Lord, and He will exalt you.

james.4.p4.b1.text: Brothers, do not slander one another. Anyone who speaks against his brother or judges him speaks against the law and judges it.

james.4.p4.b2.text: There is only one Lawgiver and Judge, the One who is able to save and destroy.

james.4.p4.b3.text: But who are you to judge your neighbor?

james.4.p5.b1.text: Come now, you who say, “Today or tomorrow we will go to this or that city, spend a year there, carry on business, and make a profit.”

james.4.p5.b2.text: You do not even know what will happen tomorrow! What is your life? You are a mist that appears for a little while and then vanishes.

james.4.p5.b3.text: Instead, you ought to say, “If the Lord is willing, we will live and do this or that.”

james.4.p5.b4.text: Anyone, then, who knows the right thing to do, yet fails to do it, is guilty of sin.
